text: ★A. NOTARISIERTES highest diploma in Chinese or EnglishProspective diploma recipients must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status or expected graduation date. Documents in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.★B.NOTARISIERTE Transcripts in Chinese or EnglishTranscripts of undergraduate education must be provided for master’s application. Transcripts of undergraduate and postgraduate education must be provided for doctoral application. Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations.★C. Two Recommendation Letters (Written in Chinese or English by 2 different professors or associate professors)These letters shall describe the applicant’s objectives of studying in China, the cooperation and exchange between the reference or recommending institutes and our university, as well as the evaluation of the applicant’s comprehensive abilities and future growth. (These letters are quite important, please do the preparation carefully.)★D. Study Plan in China or research proposal, not less than 1,000 words. The plan can include, but not limited to your willingness to study in China, description of your professional abilities and education background, your research proposal and development plan in the future, and etc.★E. English proficiency certificateIELTS, TOFEL or any other English proficiency certificate is required. Native English speaker or applicants whose official Language is English can be exempted.★F. Photocopy of Valid Passport (The expiry date should be late than September, 2025)★G. Photo (2-inch color photos with white background, full face without hat)★H. A photocopy of the Foreigner Physical Examination Form completed in English (Keep the original copy until registration). The form is designed by the Chinese quarantine authority and can be obtained from certain authority. The physical examinations must cover all the items listed in the form. Incomplete records, those without the signature of the attending physician, the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicants are invalid. Be sure the physical examination is valid during registration since it is only valid for 6 months.★I. No Criminal Record Report. The applicant shall submit a valid certificate of non-criminal record issued by the local public security authority. The report has to be issued within 6 months from the date of the application.★ J. Pre-admission letter. Please send all your application documents to tutcm@hotmail.com before February 24th, 2025 to apply for your pre-admission letter. The subject of your email name shall be in the form of “Pre-admission+nationality+name”. (The pre-admission letter plays an essential part in your scholarship application. The online application is incomplete without this letter.) K. Academic papers. (Papers published in high quality journals will increase the probability in your application.)L. Other background materials. (Providing certificates of award or professional training, medical practice license, employment certificate, or etc., which can well prove your professional abilities and potential will help your application.)
